# AKUSPACE rooms chain (draft, not yet run on a GPU)

Three LTX-2.5 segments, one character, three rooms: cathedral, small_room, empty_club.
Lengths 241 / 257 / 257 frames at 24 fps. Segments 2 and 3 are pinned at frame 0 to the last 17 decoded frames of the segment before (LTXVAddGuide), then the 17 overlap frames and their audio are trimmed before the join: 241 + 240 + 240 = 721 frames, 30.04 s.

Bypassed by default: first-frame images, depth/canny IC-LoRA, stage-2 upscale. Enable the IC-LoRA loader together with any depth guide, and every stage-2 node together. See workflows/akuspace/README.md for what is unverified.
